title: Emixa carries the strongest integration stack of the Mendix cohort, aimed at manufacturing
content:
Emixa's recorded stack is Mendix, SAP, Siemens PLM, Boomi and Solace, which the research calls the strongest integration stack of the Mendix cohort. Boomi and Solace in particular are integration and messaging tools rather than application platforms, so part of the firm's centre of gravity is moving data between systems.

The domain recorded is manufacturing. That is a straightforward differentiator within the cohort: the other Mendix leads here are noted for healthcare and public-sector work, where the audit obligation is external and statutory. Manufacturing has record requirements of its own, but they are not the same ones, and the research does not claim that they are.

Read together, the two facts place Emixa as the cohort's integration specialist rather than its best domain match. The stack means a record layer between systems is technically at home there; the domain means the case for it has to be argued on manufacturing terms rather than borrowed from the public-sector leads.
